en.headline: Police arrest driver after BMW mounts pavement in Tsim Sha Tsui killing one
en.dek: A 38-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving and dangerous driving causing death after a private car hit four pedestrians on Prat Avenue on Sunday.
body: Police arrested a 38-year-old man on Sunday evening on suspicion of drink-driving and dangerous driving causing death after a white BMW private car mounted the pavement on Prat Avenue in Tsim Sha Tsui, killing one pedestrian and injuring three others.

Officers received a report at about 2.30pm that the car had struck a lamp post and another vehicle before mounting the left-hand pavement outside 6-8 Prat Avenue, hitting four people and a shopfront. The deceased was a 53-year-old non-Chinese man who suffered severe head injuries and was certified dead at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. The three other pedestrians, aged between 31 and 70, were taken to the same hospital.

Investigators said the car had earlier struck a traffic sign on Minden Row and a parked light goods vehicle on Hart Avenue before entering Prat Avenue. The driver, who left the scene with a female passenger, was later intercepted on Austin Road. A roadside breath test showed 25 micrograms of alcohol per 100 millilitres of breath, above the statutory limit of 22. Police said they are examining the driver’s behaviour, the vehicle’s condition and the whereabouts of the passenger.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀寶勒巷寶馬劎行人路釀ᴻ死3傷 38歲男司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，一名38歲男子周日傍晚因涉嫌酒後駕駛及危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕，涉事私家車於寶勒巷衝上行人路。
body: 警方周日傍晚拘捕一名38歲男子，涉嫌酒後駕駛及危險駕駛導致他人死亡。一輚白色寶馬私家車於周日下午約2時半在尖沙咀寶勒巷衝上行人路，撞倒 4名途人，造成1死3傷。
警方接報指，涉事車輚先撞向燈柱及另一輚車，其後在寶勒巷6至8號對開衝上左邊行人路，撞向店舖及途人。死者為53歲非華裔男子，頭部重傷，送伊利沙伯醫院後證實不治。另外3名年齡介乎31至70歲的傷者亦送往同一醫院治理。
調查顯示，車輚在進入寶勒巷前，已於緬甸臺撞毀交通標誌柱，並於赫德道撞向一輚停泊的輕型貨車。司機與一名女乘客棄車離開現場，其後在柯士甸道被截獲。路邊酒精呼氣測試顯示每100毫升呼氣含25微克酒精，超過法定22微克上限。警方正循駕駛態度、車輚機件及女乘客下落等方面調查。
